skill.name: copy-editing
skill.description: Review and improve existing marketing copy through focused sweeps for clarity, tone, benefits, proof, specificity, emotion, and conversion risk.
skill.summary: Structured copy editing for marketing and conversion copy.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Review of SKILL.md found copy-editing guidance and no prompt injection, data exfiltration, or executable behavior.

content.user_title: Improve Marketing Copy with Focused Editing
content.value_statement: Marketing copy often loses clarity, proof, or urgency during revision. This skill applies focused editing sweeps to improve copy while preserving the core message.
actual_capabilities: Reviews copy through seven focused sweeps for clarity, tone, benefits, proof, specificity, emotion, and risk reduction.
Identifies unclear sentences, vague wording, weak claims, unsupported proof, and friction near calls to action.
Suggests specific edits while preserving the original message and author voice.
Provides quick word-level, sentence-level, and paragraph-level checks for faster reviews.
Supports collaborative editing with findings, recommended changes, context questions, and repeat checks.
limitations: It is designed for editing existing copy, not writing full campaigns from a blank brief.
It needs context about the audience, goal, desired action, and brand voice for best results.
It cannot verify claims, metrics, links, guarantees, or testimonials without evidence from the user.
It does not replace legal, compliance, product, or brand approval.

use_cases.title: Review Landing Pages Before Launch
use_cases.description: Audit page copy for clarity, benefit framing, proof gaps, and CTA friction before publishing.

use_cases.title: Turn Features Into Benefits
use_cases.description: Convert feature-heavy product copy into clearer messages that explain reader outcomes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Copy Reviews
use_cases.description: Use repeatable sweeps and checklists to make editing feedback consistent across drafts.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Clarity Sweep
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this copy for clarity only. Mark unclear sentences, explain each issue, and suggest concise replacements that preserve the original intent.

prompt_templates.title: Apply the Seven Sweeps
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured review of a full page
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the seven copy-editing sweeps to this page. For each sweep, list the top issues, suggested edits, and reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Strengthen Conversion Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this conversion copy for [target audience]. Preserve the brand voice, connect features to benefits, and flag claims that need evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Lead an Iterative Copy Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run an iterative review on this copy. State assumptions about audience, goal, and CTA, then provide sweep-by-sweep edits and a final consistency check.

output_examples.input: Our platform leverages advanced analytics to optimize your workflow.
output_examples.output: Suggested edit: Use analytics to find the next task faster. Reason: This replaces vague language with a clear reader benefit.

output_examples.input: Sign up now to learn more about our services.
output_examples.output: Suggested edit: Start your free trial today. See your first workflow report in 10 minutes. Reason: The CTA is specific and reduces uncertainty.

best_practices: Provide the goal, audience, desired action, and brand voice before requesting edits.
Ask for one sweep at a time when the copy is long or strategically important.
Include proof, customer quotes, metrics, and constraints so suggested edits stay accurate.
anti_patterns: Using the skill to write new copy from nothing when the task needs a copywriting workflow.
Accepting invented proof, metrics, guarantees, or testimonials.
Applying every suggestion without checking brand, legal, and product accuracy.

faq.question: What type of copy does this skill edit?
faq.answer: It is best for marketing, landing page, product, email, and conversion copy that already exists.

faq.question: Can it write copy from scratch?
faq.answer: It can suggest replacements, but its main purpose is improving existing copy through focused editing passes.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, goal, desired action, brand voice, offer details, and any required claims or proof.

faq.question: Does it preserve the original voice?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance emphasizes preserving the core message and author voice while improving clarity and persuasion.

faq.question: Can it verify marketing claims?
faq.answer: No. It can flag unsupported claims, but the user must provide source evidence for facts and metrics.

faq.question: Is this useful for fast edits?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes quick word, sentence, and paragraph checks when a full seven-sweep review is unnecessary.
